description: AI coding agents have made individual developers dramatically more productive, yet most organizations aren’t seeing anything close to that gain at the company level. A key reason is that shipping a feature to production involves far more than writing code. Triage, review, context, guardrails, and human approvals all surround the work, and agents add new risk by acting in ways teams can’t always see or control. Turning individual gains into real organizational throughput, has become one of the central challenges of the agentic era. Port is an AI software factory platform that lets platform engineers build, operate, and govern an AI software factory which is a layer that sits above the coding agents. title: The Rise of the Software Factories
